user.title: Connect to APS
user.description: Enter your APS (Arizona Public Service) account credentials. These are the same credentials you use to sign in to the APS website or mobile app.

data_description.username: The email address associated with your APS account.
data_description.password: The password you use to sign in to your APS account.

select_addresses.title: Service Addresses
select_addresses.description:
We found {count} service addresses on your account. Please select the ones you want to add to Home Assistant.

You can add both active and inactive (historical) addresses.

data_description.selected_addresses: Check all addresses you want to monitor. You can change this later in the integration options.

configure_address.title: Configure {address} ({current} of {total})
configure_address.description: Set up how you want to track this service address. Friendly names will be used to prefix all sensors for this location.

data_description.friendly_name: A short, unique name for this location (e.g., 'Home' or 'Cabin').
data_description.import_mode: Choose how much data to bring into Home Assistant. 'Full history' can take several minutes to complete in the background.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to APS. Check your network connection.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs.
error.select_one_address: Please select at least one address to monitor.
error.name_conflict: This name is already in use. Please choose a unique name.
error.name_exists: An address with this name is already configured.

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to APS to load address information.

select_addresses.title: Update Monitored Addresses
select_addresses.description: Add or remove service addresses from your Home Assistant integration. Any addresses you unselect will have their entities removed.

data_description.selected_addresses: Add or remove addresses from the currently monitored set.

configure_address.title: Update {address} ({current} of {total})
configure_address.description: Update the settings for this service address. Changing the friendly name may affect your entity IDs.

data_description.friendly_name: Change the short name for this location.
data_description.import_mode: Choose whether to backfill historical data for this address if you haven't done so yet.

error.select_one_address: Please select at least one address to monitor.
error.name_conflict: This name is already in use. Please choose a unique name.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to APS to refresh address information.
